fluff.overview: Manei Domini infantry squads operate in small, heavily augmented formations where every trooper carries cybernetic enhancements tailored to their combat role, from enhanced optics and communicator implants to dermal armor and prosthetic weapon mounts. Domini jump infantry combine cybernetic enhancement with jump capability, creating small assault teams that can drop onto elevated positions and engage with augmented strength and targeting. Their cybernetic eyes provide targeting data that conventional jump troops lack. Equipped with infantry-portable short-range missile launchers that provide anti-armor capability beyond what personal weapons can achieve, these troops can threaten light vehicles and battle armor at close range.
